findings.title: Incomplete Schema.org entity fields in JSON-LD markup
findings.evidence: Observed at https://www.forter.com/ via schema_field_validator [2026-09-13T15:53:47Z]: Schema entities are missing required properties: Organization missing name, url. (Confidence: high)

suggested_action.how_to_fix: Ensure all required fields (e.g. name, price, priceCurrency, headline) are populated in declared Schema.org blocks.
suggested_action.expected_benefit: Improves structured data by making the observed information clearer and more extractable for the intended audience.

evidence_details.observation: Schema entities are missing required properties: Organization missing name, url.

findings.severity_rationale: Rated medium because the observed evidence indicates medium impact; unavailable evidence is not treated as a defect.

findings.title: No extractable answer on-site for "How much does Forter cost?"
findings.evidence: Observed at https://www.forter.com/ via onsite_answerability_probe [2026-09-13T15:53:55Z]: Across 5 crawled page(s), no price, currency or pricing language is extractable from the crawled text. An assistant that fetched these pages could not quote an answer to "How much does Forter cost?" from this site, so it must fall back to third-party sources or omit the brand. (Confidence: medium)

suggested_action.summary: Make pricing extractable as text, not just as an image or a gated flow.
suggested_action.how_to_fix: State prices in plain HTML text and add Offer JSON-LD with price and priceCurrency. If pricing is genuinely quote-only, say so explicitly in text -- an assistant can cite "pricing is quote-based" but cannot cite silence.
suggested_action.expected_benefit: Improves citation omission by making the observed information clearer and more extractable for the intended audience.

evidence_details.observation: Across 5 crawled page(s), no price, currency or pricing language is extractable from the crawled text. An assistant that fetched these pages could not quote an answer to "How much does Forter cost?" from this site, so it must fall back to third-party sources or omit the brand.

findings.severity_rationale: Rated medium because the observed evidence indicates medium impact; unavailable evidence is not treated as a defect.

findings.title: Training-only AI crawlers are blocked; search and retrieval agents remain allowed
findings.evidence: Observed at https://forter.com/robots.txt via robots_txt_parser_longest_match [2026-09-13T15:53:47Z]: robots.txt disallows root '/' for training crawlers (CCBot, Meta-ExternalAgent, Bytespider) while leaving search-index and user-triggered agents allowed. This is a coherent licensing stance and does not prevent the brand being cited in AI answers. (Confidence: high)

suggested_action.summary: No change needed; confirm this is intentional and state the policy explicitly.
suggested_action.how_to_fix: If deliberate, make it legible by adding a Content Signals Policy block or RSL licensing terms to robots.txt so the distinction between training and retrieval is machine-readable rather than inferred from which agents you named.
suggested_action.expected_benefit: Improves crawlability by making the observed information clearer and more extractable for the intended audience.

evidence_details.observation: robots.txt disallows root '/' for training crawlers (CCBot, Meta-ExternalAgent, Bytespider) while leaving search-index and user-triggered agents allowed. This is a coherent licensing stance and does not prevent the brand being cited in AI answers.

findings.severity_rationale: Rated low because the observed evidence indicates low impact; unavailable evidence is not treated as a defect.

findings.title: No site search affordance found on any crawled page
findings.evidence: Observed at https://www.forter.com via search_affordance_detection [2026-09-13T15:53:47Z]: None of the 5 crawled pages expose a search input, a search form or role="search". A visitor who arrives on the wrong page from an AI answer has no way to find the right one without returning to the assistant. (Confidence: medium)

suggested_action.summary: Add a site search box to the persistent header.
suggested_action.how_to_fix: Add a search input in the global header and expose it with role="search". Add WebSite JSON-LD with a potentialAction SearchAction so assistants can surface your search directly.
suggested_action.expected_benefit: Improves navigation by making the observed information clearer and more extractable for the intended audience.

proactive_recommendations.title: Add Article schema with author and dateModified to editorial pages
proactive_recommendations.rationale: 1 crawled page(s) are editorial or documentation content carrying no Article schema. Authorship and a machine-readable modification date are the signals assistants use to decide whether a passage is current and attributable -- without them, an assistant that finds a good answer on the page still has no basis to date it or credit it.

suggested_action.summary: Mark editorial and documentation pages with Article JSON-LD.
suggested_action.how_to_fix: Add Article or TechArticle JSON-LD with headline, author (a Person or Organization with a real profile URL), datePublished and dateModified. Update dateModified when the content genuinely changes, not on every deploy.

proactive_recommendations.title: Expose an agent-facing endpoint (NLWeb / MCP) built on existing structured data
proactive_recommendations.rationale: The site already publishes structured data, which is the input NLWeb uses to serve a conversational endpoint that AI agents can query directly rather than scraping HTML. Because it builds on schema.org markup, sitemaps and feeds you already maintain, it is incremental rather than a rebuild, and it moves the brand from being read by agents to being queryable by them.

suggested_action.summary: Evaluate an NLWeb instance exposing an /ask and /mcp endpoint over existing content.
suggested_action.how_to_fix: Point an NLWeb instance at your existing schema.org data and sitemap, and expose /ask and /mcp. Start with the content an agent is most likely to be asked about -- catalogue, docs, pricing.
